attributes.context: Article 24 frames efficient machines, processes, methods, and materials as a mutual economic and social goal for competitiveness and secure jobs.

extraction_text: The Company will make training available to its employees so that they may have the opportunity to acquire the knowledge and skills required by the introduction of new technology.

attributes.context: The section is titled Technology Briefings and follows a Company training obligation tied to new technology.

extraction_text: In order that employees can better prepare themselves for the skill requirements of the future, and in fulfillment of its obligation to provide information to the Union Grievance Committee, the Company will, not less than semi-annually provide a briefing to the Union Grievance Committee of the company's plans for the introduction of new technology which may affect the employees.

attributes.context: The briefings occur at least semi-annually and concern company plans for new technology that may affect employees.

extraction_text: During these briefings, the company will inform the Union Grievance Committee of anticipated schedules of introduction of new technology, and will identify areas of skill impacts and any intended training programs associated with those impacts.

attributes.context: This is within the Technology Briefings section, which also covers anticipated introduction schedules, skill impacts, and training programs.

extraction_text: Included will be briefings on the implementation of computer-based systems that will result in the displacement of employees.

attributes.context: The section is titled Changes in Work under Article 24, dealing with new technology's effect on existing job duties, job descriptions, and classifications.

extraction_text: When existing job duties are affected by the new technology the Company will advise the Grievance Committee of the necessary changes to be made; the proposed job description, and the appropriate new classification. If the Company and the union cannot agree on the Company's proposed job description or classification the dispute shall be settled in accordance with Articles 8 and 22.

attributes.context: Appears in Article 24, Section 24.1, titled “Company and Union Goals,” under the article heading “New Technology.”

Section 24.3, titled Training to Qualify, follows the technology briefings and is accompanied by a provision reimbursing 100% of paid tuition fees for successfully completed job-related courses with written approval.

extraction_text: The Company will make training available to qualify employees to perform the new or changed work resulting from new technology introduction; such training programs will include the Union grievance Committee's appropriate recommendations. The Company shall first train senior employees in the classification affected by new technology.
